step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Western Union's Hub and Spoke pattern for deploying consistent architectural components across multiple accounts using AWS Service Catalog. The Hub account contains CloudFormation, Lambda, Service Catalog (Hub), CodeCommit, and CodePipeline. The Spoke account contains an imported Service Catalog (Spoke) which deploys EC2 instances and full application Tech Stacks. The flow starts with Deployment Engineers running CloudFormation stacks, triggering Lambda custom resources to share portfolios and set launch constraints on Spoke accounts. App Devs push updates to CodeCommit, triggering CodePipeline to validate and release updated products into Service Catalog.

graph.name: Western Union Multi-Account Cross-Region Architecture Deployment via Service Catalog
graph.notes: Centralized governance architecture allowing Western Union to provision standardized products across multiple AWS accounts and regions from a single Hub account.

nodes.name: DEPLOYMENT ENGINEER
nodes.notes: Deployment Engineer triggering the initial stack deployment in the Hub account.

nodes.name: APP DEV
nodes.notes: Application Developer updating product templates using a GitOps workflow.

nodes.name: CLOUDFORMATION
nodes.notes: Provisions Service Catalog portfolio, CodePipeline, and calls Lambda as a custom resource.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Custom resource Lambda that configures account parameters, shares portfolios cross-account, and sets launch constraints.

nodes.name: SERVICE CATALOG (HUB)
nodes.notes: Central Service Catalog portfolio storing approved architectural products.

nodes.name: CODECOMMIT
nodes.notes: Git repository serving as the source for CodePipeline updates.

nodes.name: CODEPIPELINE
nodes.notes: Executes syntax validation, security analysis, and deploys product updates to Service Catalog.

nodes.name: SERVICE CATALOG (SPOKE)
nodes.notes: Imported and local copy of Service Catalog portfolio in the remote Spoke account.

nodes.name: EC2
nodes.notes: Individual EC2 compute instances provisioned from Spoke Service Catalog.

nodes.name: TECH STACK
nodes.notes: Complete multi-resource application tech stacks provisioned from Spoke Service Catalog.

edges.notes: Deployment Engineer deploys CloudFormation template in Hub account.

Hub Service Catalog portfolio shared into Spoke account.
